Name: DE-TypologyGroups
Description: Extracts user typology groups of user typologies.
Statement:
select  utg.Oid as TypologyGroupId,
        utg.Name as TypologyGroup,
        com.Oid as CompanyId,
        com.Name as Company
from    UserTypologyGroup utg
            join Company com on com.Oid = utg.Company
